children: The expansion of Qatar's North Field--slated to be the largest natural gas development in history--could be a game changer for the Gulf state's 2027 economic outlook, Barclays analysts write. The project is estimated to take export capacity to 142 million metric tons a year from 77 million metric tons, marking an 84% increase. At full capacity, Barclays estimates it would increase Qatar's GDP by 30%. "This would ease external strains, reducing issuance needs, and also have sufficient revenues to subsequently raise expenditures to boost non-hydrocarbon private sector activity," the analysts add. (joseph.wilkins@wsj.com)
